_note: Manual corrections applied on top of automatic matching. gateway_aliases joins a Vercel id to an OpenRouter id when the names differ too much to match automatically. artificial_analysis_aliases pins a model id (Vercel or OpenRouter) to an Artificial Analysis slug. open_weights forces the open/closed flag for a model id. Each entry has its evidence recorded under _evidence.

_evidence.amazon/nova-*: OpenRouter appends -v1 to the same Amazon Nova model names.
_evidence.deepseek/deepseek-v3.1: Both gateways call it 'DeepSeek V3.1' at the same price (2026-10-11).
_evidence.mistral/mistral-large-3: Vercel 'Mistral Large 3', OpenRouter 'Mistral Large 3 2512', same price (2026-10-11).
_evidence.mistral/mistral-large-4: Both gateways call it 'Mistral Large 4' at the same price (2026-10-11).
_evidence.meta/muse-glimmer-30b: OpenRouter's copy of this model's AA index (17.5) equals AA's 'Muse Glimmer (High)' on 2026-10-11; AA lists no other Muse Glimmer.
